meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 你请它修 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时,它会在临时目录复现、写失败测试、做最小修复并验证;最后按归属交付:对 Codex 上游发 fork PR,对 LazyCodex 仓库只发带补丁的 issue,绝不对后者开 PR。
howto.when: 当用户要求修 bug、为 bug 开 PR,或要求贡献 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷的修复时触发。

howto.what_en: When asked to fix a LazyCodex/Codex bug, it reproduces in a temp workspace, writes a failing test, applies the smallest fix, verifies, then delivers: a fork PR for upstream Codex, or a patch-bearing issue for LazyCodex repo (never a PR).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to fix a bug, open a bug PR, or debug and contribute a fix for a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Please help fix this LazyCodex bug.
say_en.note: Files a patch-bearing issue on the LazyCodex repo.

say_en.text: This Codex CLI crash looks like an upstream bug; I'd like to open a PR.
say_en.note: Prepares a fork PR for openai/codex.

say_en.text: Debug and contribute a fix for the omo-codex issue.
say_en.note: Routes the fix to the correct target repo first.
